create.name: Stewart Pearce
create.bio:
Stewart Pearce is an English voice teacher and channeller whose spiritual work grew out of a long career in theatre. He trained as an actor and teacher of voice, worked in repertory theatre around Britain, and began coaching under the RSC's voice director Cicely Berry in 1980. He later ran voice training at the Webber Douglas Academy and spent years as Master of Voice at Shakespeare's Globe, and he still coaches speakers and performers from London.

He describes a turning point at Glastonbury Tor in 1987, when he says he received a transmission from twelve archangels he calls the Angels of Atlantis. Since then he has taught sound, breath and voice as spiritual practice alongside messages he channels from them. He now offers a monthly live online channelling workshop, one-to-one soul readings, solstice and equinox online retreats, a tiered membership community, and pilgrimages to the temples of Egypt, where he has led groups for decades. His books include The Angels of Atlantis, The Heart's Note, The Alchemy of Voice and a study of his voice work with Diana, Princess of Wales, and his YouTube channel shares channelled talks and chanting practices.

books.title: The Angels of Atlantis: Twelve Mighty Forces to Transform Your Life Forever
books.author: Stewart Pearce
books.description: Pearce introduces the twelve angels he says first spoke to him at Glastonbury in 1987, giving each one's qualities and teaching with illustrations. Exercises help readers attune to each angel in daily life.

books.title: The Heart's Note
books.author: Stewart Pearce
books.description: A study of the heart as the home of the soul, drawing on indigenous ritual and Christian mysticism. Pearce suggests daily practices of love and listening for living from the heart.

books.title: The Alchemy of Voice
books.author: Stewart Pearce
books.description: Pearce's practical manual on the voice as a person's sound signature. It sets out breath and sounding exercises for speaking with more presence and for using sound as a spiritual practice.

books.title: Diana: The Voice of Change
books.author: Stewart Pearce
books.description: Drawing on the voice coaching he gave Diana, Princess of Wales, in the last years of her life, Pearce reflects on the principles he saw guiding her. He offers exercises for readers to find their own voice and sense of purpose.

courses.title: The Resurrection Retreat: Visiting the Star Temples of Egypt
courses.description: A twelve-day pilgrimage from London based in Luxor, visiting Karnak, Philae, Edfu, Dendera, Abydos and the Great Pyramid with an Egyptologist. Pearce leads sound rituals and meditations at each temple.

courses.title: The Angels Speak: Monthly Live Channelling Workshop
courses.description: A two-hour online session held on the last Sunday of each month, in which Pearce channels the Angels of Atlantis live and takes questions from participants. Includes guided meditations and a recording.

courses.title: Soul Readings with Stewart Pearce
courses.description: One-hour private sessions combining a reading of the soul's path with angelic sound work, dream interpretation and guidance on purpose. Booked through his site.

courses.title: Angels of Atlantis Sacred Membership
courses.description: An online community in three tiers, from a free entry level with an introductory course to paid circles with the monthly live channelling, a library of meditations and chants, and the archive of past online retreats.

courses.title: Awakening the Light Codes of Your Intuition
courses.description: A recorded equinox retreat on developing intuition and subtle perception, including clairsentience and telepathy, through Pearce's angelic meditations. One of the past online retreats offered for replay.

free_resources.title: Free Angels of Atlantis Oracle Reading
free_resources.description: An online card draw introducing the twelve Angels of Atlantis, with a short message for each. It leads on to the free Awakening membership and its introductory course.

flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link.

He runs two sites: stewartpearce.com (secular voice and presence coaching in London) and theangelsofatlantis.com (his spiritual work, used as website_url). Email admin@stewartpearce.com is published on both.
Base: London from stewartpearce.com ('Voice & Presence Coaching London'); the Egypt retreat also travels from London.

Content: his work is channelled messages from 'the Angels of Atlantis'. Some recent YouTube titles are predictive or pseudo-scientific (a 'solar plasma event', 'Earth's poles have shifted', star beings about to reveal themselves, 'your DNA is awakening'); none of those was kept and none falls under the brief's conspiracy list, but please check the channel fits.

Video titles were filled by the dry run from YouTube oEmbed (the channel page served me auto-translated Portuguese titles; my own oEmbed call was refused by the permission system). Hashtag/thumbnail text and the trailing channel name were trimmed.

Books: ISBN-10s 184409569X (Findhorn Press) and 1915465079 and the Kindle ASINs B078SFMNZ5 and B078SG3F2T are taken from the links on his own store page (https://www.theangelsofatlantis.com/store); not opened on Amazon and NOT confirmed on Open Library (openlibrary.org served a human-verification page on 4 Nov 2026, so I stopped using it). Covers not checked.
The checkout page for 'The Angels Speak' returned a Cloudflare block (I reached it via a redirect from the events page's booking link); not retried, so its price is unknown.
Egypt retreat price: the page gives £8000 with a £7000 early-booking rate that ended 29 September; £8000 used. Its text also speaks of 'releasing toxins & karma'; my description leaves that out.
Photos: two from his own sites and his YouTube avatar, all clearly the same man; the IMG_4315 headshot looks older.
Dry run note: a book titled 'Diana: The Voice of Change' is already on dev under martha-beck (id 1468); probably a mis-attributed or same-title book, please check.

Angels & Keys to Paradise (book): no ISBN or link on his store page.
The free introductory course (offers/Vomb46Lg): a checkout link; not opened after the Cloudflare block.
Videos whose titles promise to heal worry, reverse ageing or forecast events (4WejCo9F_f0, KcWWct0MJl8, HNrNLnEtUp4 and similar), plus Shorts and retreat trailers under about 4 minutes.
Voice and presence coaching on stewartpearce.com: secular business coaching, not spiritual teaching.
Sahu sacred oils and the oracle app: products, not teaching.
